fundamental.en: And it is fundamental to the species. We are not a completely individualistic species.
fundamental.zh: 这是人类物种的根本属性。我们并不是一个完全个人主义的物种。

fundamental.en: The power of deep reading is really fundamental to our humanity.
fundamental.zh: 深度阅读的力量对我们的人性至关重要。

fundamental.en: They’re opportunities for France. There’s something even more fundamental here.
fundamental.zh: 它们对法国来说是机遇。这里还有更根本的东西。

fundamental.en: That's fundamental. It's sour grapes at an existential level, right?
fundamental.zh: 这很根本。这是一种存在主义层面的吃不到葡萄说葡萄酸，对吧？

fundamental.en: It's fundamental. That's so fundamental to so many things in life.
fundamental.zh: 这是根本性的。这对生活中的许多事情来说太根本了。

function.en: There is also something called a dysphemism, which functions as the opposite of a euphemism.
function.zh: 还有一种东西叫做反委婉语（dysphemism），它的功能与委婉语相反。

function.en: Hardy filled with new mathematical results, including those mysterious mock theta functions.
function.zh: Hardy信中充满了新的数学结果，包括那些神秘的仿θ函数。

function.en: In other words, he had lost virtually all of his brain function.
function.zh: 换句话说，他几乎丧失了全部脑功能。

function.en: I mean, in our work we’ve just shown that the function of memory is not about accuracy.
function.zh: 我的意思是，在我们的研究中，我们刚刚证明了记忆的功能不在于准确性。

function.en: And how do you create a government strong enough to function without creating another form of tyranny?
function.zh: 以及，你如何在不创造另一种形式的暴政的情况下，建立一个足够强大以运转的政府？

further.en: Rishi Sunak has seen his popularity drop further and further as time has passed.
further.zh: 随着时间的推移，Rishi Sunak 的支持率不断下滑。

further.en: Rishi Sunak has seen his popularity drop further and further as time has passed.
further.zh: 随着时间的推移，Rishi Sunak 的支持率不断下滑。

further.en: Unlike Britain’s colonies further south, New France never attracted an enormous number of settlers.
further.zh: 与更南端英国的殖民地不同，新法兰西从未吸引到数量庞大的定居者。

further.en: Further south on the Pacific coast of Peru, an even older culture grew.
further.zh: 更南边的秘鲁太平洋海岸，孕育了一种更古老的文化。

further.en: He continued to advise other kings and even plotted further campaigns against Rome.
further.zh: 他继续为其他君王出谋划策，甚至策划着进一步反抗罗马的战役。

furniture.en: Romans bathed in scented waters, and doused their clothes, furniture, and even their horses in fragrance.
furniture.zh: 罗马人用带香味的水沐浴，并在衣服、家具甚至马匹上喷洒香水。

furniture.en: Fountains in Versailles were filled with orange blossom water, and royal furniture was sprayed with lavender and rose extracts.
furniture.zh: 凡尔赛宫的喷泉里注满了橙花水，皇家家具上喷洒了薰衣草和玫瑰提取物。

furniture.en: That's it. And sometimes I'll go into a friend's house and I'll think the furniture in here isn't arranged in the best way.
furniture.zh: 就是这样。有时我会去朋友家，我会觉得那里的家具摆放得不是最好的方式。

furniture.en: As you can see, this is my living room. I have no furniture in there, because, like I said, it's either buy furniture or pay my mortgage.
furniture.zh: 如你所见，这就是我的客厅。里面没有任何家具，因为就像我说的，要嘛买家具，要嘛交房贷。

furniture.en: As you can see, this is my living room. I have no furniture in there, because, like I said, it's either buy furniture or pay my mortgage.
furniture.zh: 如你所见，这就是我的客厅。里面没有任何家具，因为就像我说的，要嘛买家具，要嘛交房贷。

funding.en: The national security advisor would request funding from the government for a security emergency.
funding.zh: 国家安全顾问会以应对安全紧急情况为由向政府申请资金。

funding.en: Public school funding, the money actually available for schools to use, has declined.
funding.zh: 公立学校的资金，即可供学校实际使用的资金，已经减少。

funding.en: Through countless experiments, often with limited funding and basic equipment, the Curies made extraordinary discoveries.
funding.zh: 通过无数次的实验，通常是在资金有限和设备简陋的情况下，居里夫妇做出了非凡的发现。

funding.en: These were the key materials for making weapons and funding wars.
funding.zh: 这些是制造武器和资助战争的关键材料。

funding.en: The other 70% did not receive much funding from his mayoral office.
funding.zh: 剩下的70%并没有从他的市长办公室获得多少资金。

fuse.en: The Crown and the Church were fused.
fuse.zh: 王权与教会融合在了一起。

fuse.en: And there is also the promise, or at least the allure, of nuclear fusion, the other kind of nuclear power, the one that works by fusing atoms together rather than splitting them apart.
fuse.zh: 还有核聚变的承诺，或者至少是它的诱惑力。这是另一种核能，它通过将原子融合在一起而不是将它们分裂来工作。

fund.en: Wealth in the terms of buying numerous properties or having a massive pension fund.
fund.zh: 这里所说的财富是指购买多处房产或拥有庞大的养老金基金。

fund.en: Norway created a sovereign wealth fund. A sovereign wealth fund is a government-owned investment fund.
fund.zh: 挪威创建了一个主权财富基金。主权财富基金是政府拥有的投资基金。

fund.en: Norway created a sovereign wealth fund. A sovereign wealth fund is a government-owned investment fund.
fund.zh: 挪威创建了一个主权财富基金。主权财富基金是政府拥有的投资基金。

fund.en: And if you then lost your job or fell seriously ill, you could draw from that fund.
fund.zh: 如果你随后失业或严重生病，你就可以从该基金中支取。

fund.en: Which is a very long term, but it basically means it’s funded by the government, but operates independently.
fund.zh: 这是一个很长的术语，但它基本上意味着它由政府资助，但独立运作。

furious.en: The then Justice Secretary was furious. And so were many members of the public.
furious.zh: 当时的司法大臣勃然大怒，许多公众成员也同样如此。

furious.en: His wife had discovered the affair, was understandably furious, and had threatened to leave him.
furious.zh: 他的妻子发现了这段私情，自然是勃然大怒，并威胁要离开他。

furious.en: The judge was furious. He locked the jurors up without food or drink to force a guilty verdict.
furious.zh: 法官勃然大怒，把陪审员们关起来，不给食物也不给水，想逼他们做出有罪的裁决。

furious.en: Judy returns, understandably furious. She attacks Punch, Punch attacks Judy, and before long she too has been knocked aside.
furious.zh: Judy 回来了，理所当然地勃然大怒。她攻击 Punch，Punch 反击 Judy，没过多久她也被打倒在一旁。

fur.en: French traders realized they could make a really good income from the fur trade.
fur.zh: 法国商人意识到，通过毛皮贸易，他们可以获得相当丰厚的收入。

fur.en: Lawrence River. They created an economy based on fur, animal skins.
fur.zh: 他们建立了一个以毛皮和动物皮革为基础的经济。

fur.en: They even developed " patches " of white fur.
fur.zh: 它们甚至长出了白色的“斑块”。

furthermore.en: Furthermore, oil is a damaging natural resource.
furthermore.zh: 此外，石油是一种破坏性很强的自然资源。

furthermore.en: For its critics, it is a reckless power grab, one that risks dismantling vital services, eroding public trust, and furthermore, one that looks like it will even cost, not save, the country money.
furthermore.zh: 对于批评者来说，这是一场鲁莽的权力争夺，有可能拆除重要服务、侵蚀公众信任，此外，它看起来甚至会让国家赔钱而不是省钱。

furthermore.en: Furthermore, longtime FIFA president Sepp Blatter and also UEFA president Michel Platini were kicked out of FIFA and UEFA and banned from football after it was discovered that they were sending multi-million dollar amounts of money between themselves.
furthermore.zh: 此外，长期的国际足联主席布拉特以及欧足联主席普拉蒂尼在被发现他们之间有数百万美元的资金往来后，也被开除出国际足联和欧足联，并被禁止参与足球活动。

fulfil.en: It's beauty. It's joy. It's flow. It's fulfilling.
fulfil.zh: 这是美。这是快乐。这是心流。这是满足。

fulfil.en: I have entered speech contests, I have given presentations, I have talked in front of people, and it is really fulfilling.
fulfil.zh: 我参加过演讲比赛，做过展示，在众人面前发表过讲话，这真的很有成就感。

fulfil.en: It seemed as though nuclear power would indeed fulfil Eisenhower’s vision of “Atoms for Peace,” giving the world a clean and almost limitless energy source.
fulfil.zh: 核能似乎确实实现了 Eisenhower “和平原子”的愿景，为世界提供了一种清洁且几乎取之不尽的能源。

fulfil.en: And the idea of just living an okay life just sounds so terrifying to me that the freedom to fail over and over again is still more fulfilling to me.
fulfil.zh: 而那种仅仅过着“还行”的生活的想法对我来说太可怕了，以至于一次又一次经历失败的自由对我来说仍然更有成就感。

fulfil.en: Now, clearly, the nuclear engineer most likely has better career prospects; they can get promoted, paid more, and perhaps the work is more fulfilling than in many minimum-wage jobs.
fulfil.zh: 显然，核工程师很可能拥有更好的职业前景；他们可以获得晋升，拿到更高的薪水，而且工作可能比许多最低工资的工作更有成就感。

funeral.en: Like they can't even make it to probably the single most important personal day of someone's life is someone's funeral, right?
funeral.zh: 他们甚至可能无法参加一个人一生中最重要的一天，也就是葬礼，对吧？

funeral.en: There was no state funeral, no national mourning.
funeral.zh: 没有国葬，也没有全国哀悼。

funeral.en: How do I modulate those expressions when I am in different settings, at work versus at home, at a funeral versus at a party?
funeral.zh: 在不同的场合，比如工作场合和家庭场合，葬礼和派对，我又该如何调节这些表达方式？

funeral.en: And the fact that every single person that I have in my life might not even make it to the funeral to speak over me while I'm dead.
funeral.zh: 事实上，我生命中的每一个人甚至可能都不会出现在葬礼上为我致辞。

fulfill.en: Yeah, they should make their own mistakes and learn their own lessons and have their own desires and fulfill them as is appropriate.
fulfill.zh: 是的，他们应该自己犯错，自己吸取教训，拥有自己的愿望并适当地去实现它们。

fulfill.en: If you have not, just fulfill all of them and then see if you're still feeling the same on the other side.
fulfill.zh: 如果你没有，就把它们全部满足，然后看看你在另一边是否还有同样的感觉。

furnace.en: They're now calling it a credit crisis. The global pool of money still has no idea how much money they lost, how much went into the furnace.
furnace.zh: 他们现在把它叫做信贷危机。全球资金池仍然不知道他们到底亏了多少钱，究竟有多少钱进了焚化炉。

furnace.en: Or put another way, it's as if the global pool of money thought it was putting trillions of dollars in a savings account, but really half of it was going into a furnace.
furnace.zh: 或者换句话说，这就好比全球资金池以为自己把数万亿美元存进了储蓄账户，但实际上其中一半的钱被直接扔进了焚化炉。
